entities.summary: Gloria Cabral is a Brazilian-Paraguayan architect and recipient of the Golden Lion at the Venice Biennale of Architecture and the Moira Gemmill Prize for Emerging Architecture. She was a partner at the Paraguayan firm Gabinete de Arquitectura.
